The company began with High Mix Quarries in Ataqa, building a wide customer base through high-quality aggregate materials. It later expanded by launching High Mix Ready-Mix Concrete, now operating five strategically located plants across New Cairo, Zahraa Nasr City, Obour City, the Administrative Capital, and Badr City. These operations are the result of extensive market research and are designed to meet local demand with modern technology and strict quality standards. High Mix continues to develop its integrated system to deliver reliable, high-performance concrete solutions that satisfy diverse client needs. Role Description This is a full-time, on-site Sales Engineer role based in Cairo, Egypt. The Sales Engineer will identify and pursue sales opportunities, present technical solutions to clients, and support the full sales cycle from initial contact through post-sale follow-up. Day-to-day responsibilities include understanding customer requirements, preparing technical and commercial proposals, providing product demonstrations, and coordinating with internal technical and operations teams to ensure accurate and timely delivery of solutions. The role involves responding to client inquiries, offering technical support and guidance, maintaining strong customer relationships, and updating sales reports and forecasts. The Sales Engineer will also gather market feedback to help improve offerings, contribute to pricing and negotiation discussions, and represent the company professionally in meetings and site visits. Qualifications Candidates should possess strong Sales Engineering skills, including the ability to translate technical features into practical benefits for customers. Candidates should possess solid Sales capabilities, with experience in lead generation, opportunity qualification, and closing deals. Candidates should possess effective Communication and Customer Service skills to build trust, manage expectations, and maintain long-term client relationships. Relevant bachelor’s degree in Engineering (civil, mechanical, or related field) or a closely related discipline. Experience in construction materials, ready-mix concrete, or industrial solutions in the Egyptian market is highly beneficial. Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, with attention to detail and a willingness to learn new technologies and standards. Proficiency in basic computer applications and CRM tools, and the ability to work collaboratively on-site and in the field.

review_candidates.title: Senior Backend Engineer 3
review_candidates.description: About HeyMarvin HeyMarvin is one of the fastest-growing research platforms in the galaxy. Some of the largest companies (such as Microsoft, Best Buy, LinkedIn, Sonos, and 7-11) use HeyMarvin as their secret weapon for building customer-centric solutions. Funded by notable investors like OpenAI CEO Sam Altman and first PayPal board member Scott Banister, HeyMarvin is an AI-native research system that integrates all your customer feedback and research into one central, searchable hub — so anyone can get the answers they need, when they need them. We are headquartered in Oakland, CA, with more than 100 passionate employees across three countries. We're united by our mission: To build a future where every strategic business decision is grounded in the voice of the customer. For more info, visit www.heymarvin.com. About The Role We are looking for an experienced Backend Engineer to join a fast-growing, well-funded Silicon Valley–based startup. This role offers a high level of ownership, autonomy, and the opportunity to work in a collaborative, high-performance environment with competitive compensation. Key Responsibilities Design, develop and deploy backend services with a focus on high availability, low latency and scalability Architect Distributed Systems: Design and implement robust microservices using Golang and Django that can handle concurrent processing of high-volume research data (e.g., video, audio, and large-scale text datasets). Optimize AI Workflows: Build and refine asynchronous task queues (using tools like Celery or Redis) to manage long-running AI inference tasks without impacting the responsiveness of the user-facing API. Database Performance: Design and maintain efficient schemas for both relational databases (PostgreSQL) and specialized storage (Vector databases for AI search), ensuring millisecond-level query performance as data scales into the millions of records. Load Management: Implement caching strategies and rate-limiting to protect service integrity during traffic spikes from global enterprise customers. Build and operate infrastructure, toolset and deployment pipelines Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Own and automate the provisioning of cloud resources on AWS (using Terraform or CloudFormation) to ensure environments are reproducible and scalable. CI/CD Optimization: Streamline the path from "code commit" to "production" by building automated testing and deployment pipelines that allow the team to ship multiple times a day with high confidence. Observability & Monitoring: Implement comprehensive logging, tracing, and alerting (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana, or Datadog) to proactively identify performance bottlenecks and system health issues before they affect users. Developer Experience: Create internal CLI tools or scripts to simplify the local development environment and improve the velocity of the entire engineering team. Collaborate with other engineers to create beautiful products API Stewardship: Design clean, well-documented, and intuitive RESTful or GraphQL APIs that enable frontend teams to build seamless and high-performance user interfaces. Full-Stack Synergy: Work closely with product designers and frontend engineers to understand the "Jobs to be Done," ensuring that backend logic perfectly supports complex research workflows. Technical Mentorship: Participate in rigorous code reviews and architectural whiteboarding sessions, fostering a culture of high-quality code and continuous learning. Rapid Prototyping: Transition quickly from experimental AI features to production-ready services, balancing speed-to-market with long-term code maintainability. Handling and owning security and compliance aspects for the software that the team produces. Enterprise-Grade Compliance: Build and enforce the technical controls necessary to maintain SOC2, GDPR, or HIPAA compliance, ensuring customer data is treated with the highest level of privacy. Data Isolation: Implement strict multi-tenant architecture patterns to ensure that sensitive research insights from one organization (e.g., Microsoft) are never accessible or leaked to another (e.g., 7-11). Proactive Security: Conduct regular vulnerability scanning, dependency audits, and security reviews of the codebase to defend against OWASP Top 10 threats. IAM & Encryption: Manage complex Identity and Access Management (IAM) roles and ensure all sensitive data is encrypted both at rest and in transit. Qualifications 7-9 years of experience in backend engineering Strong skills in: Python (Django) Golang Problem-solving and debugging API development and database management Good To Have Familiarity with DevOps practices (Docker, AWS, CI/CD) Experience building scalable and distributed systems Strong ownership mindset with the ability to work independently Practical, solution-oriented thinker comfortable in fast-paced, low-process environments Why Join Us? Joining HeyMarvin as a Senior Software Engineer means being part of a high-growth, transparent, and empowering environment where your work has direct impact. You’ll collaborate with talented teammates, work with modern technologies, and help build a world-class product at the intersection of AI, research, and enterprise software-while having the autonomy to shape both your role and the company’s future. About The Team You’ll be joining a lean, high-performing team that values ownership, speed, and thoughtful execution. The team operates with minimal bureaucracy and emphasizes collaboration, continuous learning, and delivering meaningful outcomes. Compensation ₹45-50LPA, plus benefits.

The role has a strong focus on system architecture, security, and API and web performance, built on microservices and event-driven architecture using the MERN stack. The ideal candidate combines deep technical expertise with strong project management and communication skills, and actively uses AI tools to raise the team’s speed and quality. Your primary goal will be to build scalable, secure, high-performing systems and lead a team that delivers them predictably. Key Responsibilities Technical Leadership & Team Management Lead, grow, and coach a team of full stack engineers, staying hands-on with architecture, code, and technical decisions rather than managing from a distance. Conduct code reviews and provide clear, constructive feedback that raises the team’s engineering bar. Establish coding standards, development processes, and quality assurance practices, including testing strategy and CI/CD. System Architecture Own the end-to-end system architecture of the platform, from API design to deployment. Design and evolve scalable systems using microservices and event-driven architecture, defining service boundaries, integration patterns, and data ownership. Collaborate with product managers and partners to define technical requirements and drive architectural decisions. Document key technical decisions and trade-offs, balancing delivery speed with long-term maintainability. Performance & Reliability (API & Web) Optimize API performance: latency, throughput, error rates, caching, and query optimization. Optimize web performance: Core Web Vitals, bundle size, rendering, and load times. Build observability across services, including logging, metrics, distributed tracing, and alerting, to ensure high reliability and uptime. Delivery & Project Management Oversee the entire software development lifecycle, from concept to deployment and maintenance. Manage project timelines, resources, and deliverables to ensure predictable, high-quality releases. Communicate technical plans, progress, risks, and trade-offs clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders. AI & Innovation Drive effective and safe use of AI tools across the team for coding, code reviews, testing, and documentation. Stay up-to-date with emerging technologies and industry trends, recommending and implementing improvements as needed. Required Qualifications: 7+ years of professional software engineering experience, including 3+ years in a technical leadership role (tech lead or team lead). 5+ years of hands-on experience with Node.js and Express.js in production (TypeScript preferred). Deep knowledge with MongoDB, including data modeling, indexing, aggregation pipelines, and performance tuning; experience with Redis for caching. Knowledge with designing and building microservices and event-driven systems. Knowledge with cloud platforms (AWS preferred) and CI/CD Pipeline. Strong practical knowledge of application and API security (OWASP Top 10, OAuth2/JWT, secure cloud configuration). Proven track record of measurable API and web performance improvements. Strong project management skills: breaking down work, estimating, managing priorities, and delivering on time. Excellent communication skills in English, both written and verbal. Daily, practical use of AI tools (e.g. Claude, Cursor, GitHub Copilot) in the development workflow. Preferred: Experience building products on top of LLM or generative AI APIs. Experience with serverless architecture (AWS Lambda or similar).

review_candidates.title: Senior Software Engineer
review_candidates.description: As Virtuagym keeps on growing, we are now looking for a new face to complement our Development team. As a Software Engineer, you will be joining the team responsible for our Blue domain, which focuses on billing & payments. Will you join us in our quest to create a healthier and happier world? Join a high performing team and make an impact! We're a passionate, driven team with a strong focus on growth and delivering outstanding results. At Virtuagym, we cultivate a high-performance culture built on dedication, ownership and driving excellence. If you're a self-starter who embraces challenges, thrives in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, this could be the perfect role for you! In return, you'll join a team where you can grow, develop, and truly unlock your full potential. We have a beautiful office in the center of Amsterdam and while we foster getting together to exchange ideas and energy, we are a remote-friendly company. This is a full time and remote position from Turkey where you will be working for our global teams. What this role looks like As a senior engineer on Blue Domain, you'll own the systems that handle billing and payments for fitness businesses serving more than 35 million end users. In billing and payments, every bug is someone's money, so clear design, reliability and good judgment matter here more than almost anywhere else. You'll work mostly in PHP on a platform that is moving toward event-driven services with Kafka. You'll take the lead on technical design, work closely with Product to turn business problems into clear plans, and help the engineers around you grow. Responsibilities Owning technical design for features and services in billing and payments, from first sketch to running in production Designing solutions that are simple, scalable, and actually make sense, not just technically correct Making architecture decisions others build on, and explaining the trade-offs clearly enough that the team can challenge them Deciding with the team what to refactor, what to rebuild and what to leave alone, and levelling up our architecture with current best practices Keeping the production systems your team owns reliable and observable, so issues get caught by our monitoring, not from a customer complaint Working directly with Product to turn messy business problems into clear, buildable plans Speaking up early: sharing progress, asking questions before you're stuck, and asking for feedback rather than waiting for it Giving code reviews that are honest, kind, and actually useful - the kind you'd want to receive yourself Mentoring other engineers through reviews, pairing and design discussions, and being someone people tap on the shoulder for advice Writing docs and diagrams your teammates will genuinely reach for later Having a real voice in what we build next, through Sprint and Product Backlog planning Bringing your own take on how we work, and helping the team improve it Our tech stack PHP, Python, Vue.js, NodeJS Kafka, ksqlDB, Kafka Connect Kotlin, Swift, Objective-C MariaDB, MongoDB, RabbitMQ, Elasticsearch, Redis AWS, Docker, Kubernetes, Helm, Vault, GitLab What you'll bring Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, a related field, or equivalent experience 5+ years of professional experience in software development, building and running systems in production Deep, hands-on production experience with PHP - this is a hard requirement for this role, experience with Python is a strong plus A track record of designing systems, not just implementing tickets: you've made architecture decisions and lived with the consequences Strong relational database skills, including data modelling and performance tuning Testing, observability and reliability as your default way of working, not an afterthought Experience mentoring other engineers or raising the bar of a team Comfort using AI tools in your daily work, with the judgment to know when not to trust them A track record of contributing to improvements in the Development Lifecycle Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate with Product Management to create actionable product specifications Experience with version control and various git workflows Strong written and verbal communication skills in English, our company language Knowledge of the agile philosophy and how to implement it, like Scrum and DevOps lifecycles (plan, code, build, test, release, deploy, operate, monitor) Bonus points if you'll bring: Experience with distributed services and event-driven applications Experience working with Vue.js A well-curated portfolio An obsession with customer satisfaction Important note: please do apply if you meet 80%+ of the criteria. At Virtuagym we hire great people, not just resumes. If you can't check off a few requirements but are a fast learner, we'd love to hear from you. If you have read everything carefully, please add a 🍓 in the “anything you would like to add” section. Ready to join us? Please do not hesitate to apply by clicking the ‘Apply for this Job’ button below! We will get back to your application within 10 working days. For any questions on the vacancy, please get in touch with the recruitment team at recruitment@virtuagym.com . The hiring process The hiring process for this role consists of: Screening call with Recruitment 1st interview with two Software Engineers in which you will show a project you’ve built and are proud of and explain why you decided to build it the way you did. Make sure to show us the parts that you’re most proud of or were hardest to get right. 2nd interview with our CTO and CIO * Please note that we do not collaborate with third parties to fill this vacancy, so third parties are kindly asked not to contact us about this role.
